visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: getOrDefault Instead of containsKey Branches
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A TreeMap counts the letters with an if/else that checks containsKey first. Use getOrDefault to do it in one line. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: getOrDefault supplies 0 for a letter not seen yet, so the "first time or not" branch disappears, and the map is looked up fewer times. A TreeMap keeps the letters sorted.
